title: Jazz albums
statementMd:
List the titles and release years of Jazz albums.

Expected columns: `title`, `release_year`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, release_year FROM albums WHERE genre = 'Jazz';
```
